en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a traditional two‑storey inn with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, fronting a cobblestone street. Flower boxes and parasols line a terrace behind a low wall. Trees rise behind and to the side of the building. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge in German, identifying the spa town and the guesthouse. Additional text is faintly visible on the facade above the entrance.
